documentation.content:
More than 5 responses with a 5xx status from saferoute-api within 5 minutes, as Cloud Run counted them.

What to do: docs/runbooks/alerts-staging.md, section "When an alert arrives". Do not paste project ids, URLs or tokens when asking for help.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "saferoute-api" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"
